coverage_gaps: No dedicated citation-graph route is available; backward references can be followed from PubMed records, while comprehensive forward-citation coverage remains incomplete.
No preprint route is available, so unpublished work and preprint status changes cannot be searched systematically; peer-reviewed confirmation remains the evidentiary threshold.
No ancestry-specific population genetics database, ClinVar route, or GWAS catalog route is available; variant classification and frequency conclusions depend on PubMed-indexed primary studies.
No structural repository or proteomics repository route is available, so deposited structures, raw phosphoproteomics datasets, and accession-level validation require follow-up outside this plan.
FDA coverage is jurisdiction-specific and may yield no LRRK2-directed approval record; non-US regulatory decisions are outside the available routes.
Full-text access and non-English screening capacity are unspecified, which may limit verification of older discovery reports or regional variant studies.
ClinicalTrials.gov cannot guarantee coverage of unregistered early studies or trials registered exclusively in other national registries.
exclusion_criteria: Records mentioning LRRK2 or Parkinson disease only incidentally without evidence relevant to genetics, mechanism, substrates, limitations, biomarkers, intervention, or safety are excluded.
Purely computational predictions, docking results, pathway enrichment, or network associations without experimental or human-genetic validation are excluded from direct mechanistic support.
Reviews, editorials, commentaries, conference-only abstracts, and news items are excluded as sole support for substantive causal claims.
Studies published or materially updated after 2024-12-31 are excluded from the brief and logged for a future update wave.
Claims about non-LRRK2 kinases, unrelated parkinsonism genes, or generic neurodegeneration are excluded unless they directly test an LRRK2 interaction or mechanistic boundary.
Candidate substrate reports lacking demonstrated LRRK2-dependent phosphorylation are excluded from the physiological-substrate tier and may be retained only as pathway hypotheses.
Animal or cellular phenotypes with no defined relationship to LRRK2 perturbation, disease-associated variants, or validated target engagement are excluded.
Patent-only claims and preprints without peer-reviewed confirmation are excluded from confirmatory evidence under the available source routes.
Exact duplicate canonical records are excluded from double counting while every originating query occurrence remains preserved.
inclusion_criteria: Record date is on or before 2024-12-31 after checking publication, online-first, correction, registry-update, and regulatory effective dates separately.

Human genetic studies are included when they address LRRK2 discovery, variant pathogenicity or risk, ancestry, penetrance, segregation, association, or genotype-phenotype and neuropathology relationships.

Biochemical, structural, cellular, organoid, animal, or human-tissue studies are included when they directly test LRRK2 enzymatic activity, variant effects, substrates, target engagement, or a defined downstream pathway.

Substrate claims require explicit evidence of phosphorylation or enzymatic dependence; physiological-substrate designation additionally requires endogenous context, perturbation, in vivo evidence, or orthogonal validation.

Null, negative, contradictory, replication, incomplete-penetrance, pathological-heterogeneity, loss-of-function, safety, correction, retraction, and failed or terminated trial records are included when they can limit the proposed mechanism.
Clinical trial and FDA records are included when they establish translational testing, biomarker use, target engagement, safety, disposition, or regulatory status of LRRK2-directed interventions.
Peer-reviewed primary studies are prioritized; reviews may enter as discovery and citation-expansion records, while final factual claims are traced to primary evidence.
All organisms and languages are eligible when mechanistically relevant and minimally screenable from an English title or abstract; unavailable full-text language support is recorded as a limitation.
Duplicate query hits are retained as query-to-record links and merged only at the canonical record level using PMID, DOI, NCT number, FDA document identity, and bibliographic reconciliation.

queries.purpose: Recover anchor reports for PARK8 linkage, identification of LRRK2 mutations, and early recurrent pathogenic variants before expanding terminology.
queries.query: (("LRRK2"[Title/Abstract] OR "leucine-rich repeat kinase 2"[Title/Abstract] OR "PARK8"[Title/Abstract] OR "dardarin"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Parkinson Disease"[Mesh] OR "Parkinson disease"[Title/Abstract] OR parkinsonism[Title/Abstract]) AND (linkage[Title/Abstract] OR mutation*[Title/Abstract] OR G2019S[Title/Abstract] OR R1441C[Title/Abstract] OR Y1699C[Title/Abstract] OR I2020T[Title/Abstract]))

queries.purpose: Verify anchor evidence identifying Rab proteins as LRRK2 kinase substrates and expose missing substrate aliases.
queries.query: ((LRRK2[Title/Abstract] OR "leucine-rich repeat kinase 2"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Rab GTPases"[Mesh] OR "Rab GTPase"[Title/Abstract] OR Rab8A[Title/Abstract] OR Rab10[Title/Abstract] OR Rab12[Title/Abstract]) AND (substrate*[Title/Abstract] OR phosphoproteom*[Title/Abstract] OR phosphorylat*[Title/Abstract]))

queries.purpose: Maximize recall for discovery history, pathogenic and risk variants, population frequencies, penetrance, and genotype-phenotype relationships.
queries.query: (("Parkinson Disease"[Mesh] OR "Parkinson disease"[Title/Abstract] OR parkinsonism[Title/Abstract]) AND (LRRK2[Title/Abstract] OR "leucine-rich repeat kinase 2"[Title/Abstract] OR PARK8[Title/Abstract] OR dardarin[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Genetic Association Studies"[Mesh] OR "Genetic Predisposition to Disease"[Mesh] OR variant*[Title/Abstract] OR mutation*[Title/Abstract] OR genotype*[Title/Abstract] OR penetrance[Title/Abstract] OR linkage[Title/Abstract] OR "founder effect"[Title/Abstract]))

queries.purpose: Retrieve biochemical and structural evidence for kinase, GTPase, domain-coupling, activation, and variant-dependent enzymatic mechanisms.
queries.query: ((LRRK2[Title/Abstract] OR "leucine-rich repeat kinase 2"[Title/Abstract] OR PARK8[Title/Abstract] OR dardarin[Title/Abstract]) AND (kinase[Title/Abstract] OR GTPase[Title/Abstract] OR "ROC domain"[Title/Abstract] OR "COR domain"[Title/Abstract] OR ROCO[Title/Abstract] OR autophosphorylation[Title/Abstract] OR structure[Title/Abstract] OR "cryo-EM"[Title/Abstract]) AND (mechanis*[Title/Abstract] OR activit*[Title/Abstract] OR conformation*[Title/Abstract] OR phosphorylat*[Title/Abstract]))

queries.purpose: Map proposed physiological substrates and downstream pathways while retaining both direct-substrate and broader pathway evidence.
queries.query: ((LRRK2[Title/Abstract] OR "leucine-rich repeat kinase 2"[Title/Abstract]) AND (substrate*[Title/Abstract] OR interactome[Title/Abstract] OR phosphoproteom*[Title/Abstract] OR phosphorylat*[Title/Abstract]) AND (Rab*[Title/Abstract] OR lysosom*[Title/Abstract] OR autophag*[Title/Abstract] OR mitophag*[Title/Abstract] OR vesicle*[Title/Abstract] OR cilia*[Title/Abstract] OR microtubule*[Title/Abstract] OR alpha-synuclein[Title/Abstract] OR SNCA[Title/Abstract] OR tau[Title/Abstract]))

queries.purpose: Confirm direct variant-specific functional evidence and prevent extrapolation from G2019S to all pathogenic or risk variants.
queries.query: ((LRRK2[Title/Abstract]) AND (G2019S[Title/Abstract] OR R1441C[Title/Abstract] OR R1441G[Title/Abstract] OR R1441H[Title/Abstract] OR Y1699C[Title/Abstract] OR I2020T[Title/Abstract] OR N1437H[Title/Abstract] OR G2385R[Title/Abstract] OR R1628P[Title/Abstract]) AND (kinase[Title/Abstract] OR GTPase[Title/Abstract] OR phosphorylat*[Title/Abstract] OR Rab10[Title/Abstract] OR pathogenic*[Title/Abstract] OR penetrance[Title/Abstract]))

queries.purpose: Prioritize causal substrate evidence based on endogenous phosphorylation, genetic perturbation, in vivo models, and pharmacologic target engagement.
queries.query: ((LRRK2[Title/Abstract]) AND (Rab8A[Title/Abstract] OR Rab10[Title/Abstract] OR Rab12[Title/Abstract] OR Rab29[Title/Abstract] OR RAB7L1[Title/Abstract] OR RILPL1[Title/Abstract] OR RILPL2[Title/Abstract]) AND (endogenous[Title/Abstract] OR physiological[Title/Abstract] OR "in vivo"[Title/Abstract] OR knockout[Title/Abstract] OR knock-in[Title/Abstract] OR inhibitor[Title/Abstract]) AND (substrate*[Title/Abstract] OR phosphorylat*[Title/Abstract] OR "target engagement"[Title/Abstract]))

queries.purpose: Retrieve evidence limiting causal strength or generality, including incomplete penetrance, pathological heterogeneity, population-specific effects, loss-of-function tolerance, and null or conflicting findings.
queries.query: ((LRRK2[Title/Abstract] OR "leucine-rich repeat kinase 2"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Parkinson disease"[Title/Abstract] OR parkinsonism[Title/Abstract]) AND ("incomplete penetrance"[Title/Abstract] OR "age-dependent penetrance"[Title/Abstract] OR heterogeneity[Title/Abstract] OR "absence of Lewy bodies"[Title/Abstract] OR "loss-of-function"[Title/Abstract] OR "null result"[Title/Abstract] OR negative[Title/Abstract] OR contradict*[Title/Abstract] OR replication[Title/Abstract]))

queries.purpose: Identify corrections, retractions, expressions of concern, and publication-integrity limitations affecting key claims.
queries.query: ((LRRK2[Title/Abstract] OR "leucine-rich repeat kinase 2"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Published Erratum"[Publication Type] OR "Retracted Publication"[Publication Type] OR "Retraction of Publication"[Publication Type] OR correction[Title] OR retraction[Title] OR "expression of concern"[Title/Abstract]))

queries.purpose: Locate synthesis papers whose reference lists and cited primary studies can support backward and forward expansion, with all mechanistic claims verified in primary records.
queries.query: ((LRRK2[Title/Abstract] OR "leucine-rich repeat kinase 2"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Parkinson Disease"[Mesh] OR "Parkinson disease"[Title/Abstract]) AND (review[Publication Type] OR systematic review[Title/Abstract] OR consensus[Title/Abstract]) AND (genetic*[Title/Abstract] OR mechanism*[Title/Abstract] OR substrate*[Title/Abstract] OR Rab[Title/Abstract]))

queries.purpose: Identify registered interventional and observational studies testing LRRK2-directed therapies, biomarkers, target engagement, and genotype-defined cohorts.
queries.query: AREA[ConditionSearch](Parkinson Disease OR Parkinsonism) AND AREA[InterventionSearch](LRRK2 OR leucine-rich repeat kinase 2 OR DNL201 OR DNL151 OR BIIB122 OR NEBLERDOMSTAT)

queries.purpose: Retrieve failed, terminated, negative, and safety-focused trial evidence that constrains translational interpretation of kinase inhibition.
queries.query: AREA[ConditionSearch](Parkinson Disease OR Parkinsonism) AND (AREA[InterventionSearch](LRRK2 inhibitor OR DNL201 OR DNL151 OR BIIB122 OR NEBLERDOMSTAT) OR AREA[OtherTerms](adverse event OR safety OR lung OR pulmonary OR renal OR kidney OR discontinued OR terminated))

queries.purpose: Check FDA records for regulatory status, safety communications, labels, reviews, or the absence of approved LRRK2-directed indications through the cutoff.
queries.query: ("LRRK2" OR "leucine-rich repeat kinase 2" OR "DNL201" OR "DNL151" OR "BIIB122" OR "NEBLERDOMSTAT") AND ("Parkinson disease" OR parkinsonism OR "kinase inhibitor")

queries.purpose: Capture late-breaking genetic, mechanistic, substrate, biomarker, and translational studies through the exact as_of date; inspect online-first and correction dates separately.
queries.query: ((LRRK2[Title/Abstract] OR "leucine-rich repeat kinase 2"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Parkinson Disease"[Mesh] OR "Parkinson disease"[Title/Abstract] OR parkinsonism[Title/Abstract]) AND ("2023/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication]))

queries.purpose: Capture trial registrations and record updates posted during the final two years while preserving original registration and update dates.
queries.query: AREA[ConditionSearch](Parkinson Disease OR Parkinsonism) AND AREA[OtherTerms](LRRK2 OR DNL201 OR DNL151 OR BIIB122 OR NEBLERDOMSTAT) AND AREA[LastUpdatePostDate]RANGE[01/01/2023, 12/31/2024]

question_frame: Target-mechanism and translational evidence frame: through 2024-12-31, determine how human genetic discovery and disease-associated LRRK2 variants connect leucine-rich repeat kinase 2 activity to Parkinson disease; distinguish variant-specific effects from general disease mechanisms; identify enzymatic functions, physiological substrates, cellular pathways, organism and tissue contexts, and human translational evidence; actively retrieve null, contradictory, replication, penetrance, correction, retraction, and intervention-safety evidence. Scope is database inception through the as_of date, human genetic and biomarker studies, biochemical and structural studies, cellular and animal models, registered human trials, and FDA regulatory records; all organisms are eligible when mechanistically informative, and all languages are eligible when an English title or abstract permits screening, with full-text language limitations recorded.
stop_rules: Complete every planned query across pubmed, clinicaltrials_gov, and fda_regulatory and record exact query, execution timestamp, cutoff handling, result count, and provider or database version.

Recover anchor evidence for PARK8 linkage and LRRK2 identification, recurrent pathogenic variants, variant-dependent enzymatic effects, and Rab-family substrate phosphorylation; expand aliases and rerun affected waves when an anchor is missing.
Complete separate genetic-discovery, enzymatic-mechanism, physiological-substrate, translational, and limiting-evidence branches before synthesis.
Continue backward and forward citation expansion from eligible anchors and major syntheses until two consecutive expansion passes add no decision-relevant primary evidence.
Stop a branch when further retrieval cannot change its confidence judgment, variant-specific interpretation, physiological-substrate classification, or stated limitation.

Escalate conflicting duplicate metadata, incompatible results from nominally identical samples, retractions, corrections, or unresolved variant nomenclature for manual resolution; fail closed on unresolved conflicts.
End retrieval when planned routes are exhausted and all included claims can be traced to primary records, or when the predefined search budget is reached with remaining gaps explicitly reported.
Preserve search waves independently and treat changing result counts as database-version observations rather than evidence of scientific change.
